publish.playDraftUnchanged: Google Play did not answer, and the draft it shows is unchanged. A commit can take a while to show: check Play Console, then preview the push again. Nothing is written until you confirm a new preview.
publish.playNoVersions: Google Play has no versions to create: a version there is a release, made in the release steps.
publish.playRolloutUnchanged: Google Play did not answer, and it still shows the old state. A commit can take a while to show: check Play Console, then preview the rollout again. Nothing is changed until you confirm a new preview.
publish.playSubmitUnknown: Google Play did not answer, so it is not known whether the changes were sent to review. Google Play shows no review state through its API: look at the app in Play Console. Nothing is sent again until you preview and confirm again (Google refuses a second send while changes are in review).
publish.releaseNotApplied: The store did not answer, and reading it back shows the version is still waiting for release. Nothing was released as far as the store shows. Preview again to try again.
publish.rolloutNotApplied: The store did not answer, and reading its state back shows the old state, so the change was not applied. Nothing was changed. Preview again to try again.
publish.rolloutOther: The store shows a state that is neither the old one nor the requested one. Nothing more was done. Review it and preview again.
publish.shareRequired: Name the share of users to release to, more than 0 and at most 1 (1 is everybody). It is never implied.
publish.stepStopped: The step stopped unexpectedly, so it is not known whether it reached the store. Look at the app in the store, then preview again.
publish.stillRunning: The publish is still running and has not gone quiet. It was not stopped.
publish.submitNotApplied: The store did not answer, and reading it back shows the version was not submitted. Nothing was submitted as far as the store shows. Preview again to try again.
publish.unknown.draftBeforeRelease: It is not known whether the last draft push reached the store. Preview that push again first (staged changes), then release.
publish.unknown.draftBeforeSubmit: It is not known whether the last draft push reached the store. Preview that push again first (staged changes), then submit.
publish.unknown.draftPush: It is not known whether the last draft push of this app reached the store. Preview the push again: that reads the store and shows where it stands. Nothing is written until you confirm a new preview.
publish.unknown.draftReached: It is not known whether the draft reached the store: the store did not answer and its draft could not be read back. Preview the push again to see where it stands; nothing is written until you confirm a new preview.
publish.unknown.pushSubmitReached: It is not known whether the changes reached Google Play and were sent for review: Google Play did not answer and the store could not be read back. Look at the app in Play Console (Publishing overview), then preview again. Nothing is sent again until you confirm a new plan.
publish.unknown.pushSubmitUnchanged: Google Play did not answer, and what it shows is unchanged. A commit can take a while to show, and Google Play shows no review state through its API: check Play Console (Publishing overview), then preview again. Nothing is sent again until you confirm a new plan.
publish.unknown.release: It is not known whether the last release of this app reached the store. Look at the app in App Store Connect or Play Console, then preview the release again: that reads the store and shows where it stands. Nothing is released until you confirm a new preview.
publish.unknown.releaseReached: It is not known whether the release reached the store: the store did not answer and could not be read back. Look at the app in App Store Connect or Play Console, then preview again. Nothing is released until you confirm a new preview.
publish.unknown.rollout: It is not known whether the last rollout change of this app reached the store. Preview the rollout again: that reads the store and shows where it stands. Nothing is changed until you confirm a new preview.
publish.unknown.rolloutReached: It is not known whether the change reached the store: the store did not answer and its state could not be read back. Preview the rollout again to see where it stands; nothing is changed until you confirm a new preview.
publish.unknown.submit: It is not known whether the last submit of this app reached the store. Look at the app in App Store Connect or Play Console, then preview the submit again: that reads the store and shows where it stands. Nothing is submitted until you confirm a new preview.
publish.unknown.submitBeforeRelease: It is not known whether the last submit for review reached the store. Preview that submit again first, then release.
publish.unknown.submitReached: It is not known whether the version was submitted: the store did not answer and could not be read back. Look at the app in App Store Connect, then preview again. Nothing is submitted until you confirm a new preview.
publish.unknown.version: It is not known whether the version was created: App Store Connect did not answer in a way that says. Look at the app in App Store Connect, then preview again. Nothing is created until you confirm a new preview.
publish.versionsChanged: The versions in App Store Connect changed since this was previewed, so nothing was created. Review the new preview and confirm it.
